motivation: CMP v1 failed. Independently evaluate selective streaming adaptation on GRAPE released bundles.
splits: Official train used for base fitting. Official valid+test are development. Official unseen reserved for final evaluation once. Dataset 1 and 2 both reported, no cherry picking.
features: Preserve exported column order for all splits. Do not apply the upstream runner's different unseen feature permutation. This is a controlled adaptation study, not a reproduction of published scores. Raw feature semantics and wafer identifiers are unavailable.
prediction: Prequential: predict sample before optionally obtaining its label. Each label request is selected using current/past features and past queried labels only. Zero feedback delay initially; report as limitation.
methods: upstream GRAPE model with 100 percent labels
upstream GRAPE with uniform sparse labels
Bayesian residual adapter with uniform sparse labels
same Bayesian adapter with random sparse labels
REFLEX same adapter with causal uncertainty-based requests
candidate: Bayesian recursive residual model with per-context offset, process-noise covariance inflation and bounded updates. This is a lightweight trained model, not a foundation model; novelty is unproven.
selection: Every 50-sample block has fixed label quota. Current posterior variance compared with past-only variance quantile; quota enforced without future features or labels.
development_selection: Choose residual feature count and process noise on pooled uniform-sampling development error, giving all selection strategies the same adapter. Base ridge alpha is the upstream default. All settings fixed before unseen evaluation.
success: Primary: at 20 percent labels, REFLEX RMSE <=1.02 times full-label GRAPE and p90 absolute error <=1.05 times full-label GRAPE, on each dataset. Separately require evidence of advantage over same-budget baselines to claim proprietary selection benefit.
statistics: Paired 50-sample block bootstrap; seeds are repetitions, not independent production runs. Report all methods and failed gates.
limitations: Anonymized exported features, no raw sensor validation
Original per-feature export alignment not independently verified
No real equipment or production ROI validation
timestamp_note: Creation timestamp corrected to filesystem birthtime; experimental criteria unchanged.
